results.question: What action shall the UE take upon receiving an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST with an EPS bearer identity matching an already activated dedicated EPS bearer context?
results.reference: the UE shall locally deactivate the existing dedicated EPS bearer context and proceed with the requested default EPS bearer context activation
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 6.4.1.5, Abnormal cases in the UE
results.model_answer: The UE shall reject the message with an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message, using EPS bearer identity of the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message and ESM cause #23 'invalid EPS bearer identity'.
results.evidence: If the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains an EPS bearer identity that is already assigned to an active dedicated EPS bearer context, the UE shall reject the request with an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message with ESM cause #23 'invalid EPS bearer identity'.

results.question: Which EPS bearer contexts are deactivated when a duplicate default EPS bearer context activation request is received for an already activated default bearer?
results.reference: the existing default EPS bearer context and all the associated dedicated EPS bearer contexts, if any

results.evidence: If the UE receives an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with an EPS bearer identity that is already assigned, the UE shall locally deactivate the EPS bearer context if it was successfully established, or if not, locally release the assigned EPS bearer identity, prior to the processing of the new request. Any associated dedicated EPS bearer contexts as well as the default EPS bearer context of the PDN connection shall be treated as locally deactivated.

results.question: When shall the UE include the IMEISV information element?
results.reference: if the IMEISV was requested within the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
results.model_answer: When the network has requested the UE to include its IMEISV, the UE shall include the IMEISV information element in the relevant NAS message.
results.evidence: If the UE has a valid IMEISV and the network has requested the UE to provide its IMEISV, the UE shall include the IMEISV information element in the ATTACH REQUEST, TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST, or CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.

results.question: Under what condition is the UE required to include the IMEISV IE?
results.reference: if the IMEISV was requested within the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the IMEISV IE when the UE requests the setting of the network provided IMEISV, or when it is required by the upper layers, or when the ATTACH REQUEST/TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message is sent without a valid GUTI and the UE has no valid IMSI/IMEISV combination stored, specifically: the UE shall include the IMEISV if it has no valid GUTI and no valid IMSI available, i.e., the UE shall include the Mobile identity IMEISV IE in the ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message when the UE does not have a valid GUTI or a valid IMSI available.
results.evidence: If the UE does not have a valid GUTI or a valid IMSI available, the UE shall include the IMEISV in the Mobile identity IE of the ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

results.question: What triggers the UE to include the IMEISV information element?

results.evidence: "If the identification request... indicates that IMEISV is requested, the UE shall include the IMEISV in the identity response message." (TS 24.301, clause 5.4.4.2 - Identification procedure, UE initiated actions)

results.question: In which message must the IMEISV be requested for the UE to include it?
results.reference: within the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
results.model_answer: The IDENTITY REQUEST message (with the Identity type IE set to IMEISV) is the message in which the network must request the IMEISV before the UE will include it in the IDENTITY RESPONSE message.
results.evidence: "The IMEISV shall only be included in the IDENTITY RESPONSE message if the network has requested it in the IDENTITY REQUEST message with the identity type set to IMEISV." (3GPP TS 24.301, clause 9.9.3.20 / 5.4.4)

results.question: What two procedures can cause the UE to enter the PLMN-SEARCH substate as a result of a network rejection?

results.question: What shall the UE do with the tracking area updating attempt counter if a new PLMN is selected?

results.question: What substate is entered if a suitable cell is found and the PLMN or tracking area is not forbidden?
results.reference: NORMAL-SERVICE

results.question: When shall the MME retransmit a DETACH ACCEPT message if it was not delivered due to an intra MME handover?
results.reference: upon successful completion of the intra MME handover

results.model_answer: The MME shall retransmit the DETACH ACCEPT message once the tracking area updating procedure triggered by the intra MME handover is completed.
results.evidence: If a NAS signalling connection exists, the network shall deliver the DETACH ACCEPT message before releasing the NAS signalling connection. results.question: What action shall the MME take if a DETACH ACCEPT message was not delivered due to a handover failure but the S1 signalling connection still exists?

results.model_answer: The MME shall retransmit the DETACH ACCEPT message.
results.evidence: If the S1 signalling connection still exists after the DETACH ACCEPT message could not be delivered due to a handover failure, the MME shall retransmit the DETACH ACCEPT message.

results.question: What does the UE do if the T3448 value IE is present in the SERVICE ACCEPT message and the value indicates the timer is zero or deactivated?
results.reference: the UE shall consider this case as an abnormal case and proceed as if the T3448 value IE is not present
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.6.1.4.2, UE is using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization
results.model_answer: If the T3448 value IE is present and indicates zero or deactivated, the UE shall stop timer T3448 if it is running and shall consider the timer as if it was not running (i.e., it shall not start or restart T3448).
results.evidence: If the T3448 value IE is present and the value indicates that the timer is neither zero nor deactivated, the UE shall create or update T3448... If the value indicates that the timer is zero or deactivated, the UE shall stop the timer T3448, if running, and shall consider the timer T3448 as if it was not running.

results.question: Under what condition shall the WLAN offload indication IE be included in the message?

results.question: What does the network indicate via the WLAN offload indication IE regarding the UE?
results.reference: if the UE is allowed to offload the traffic of the associated PDN connection to WLAN(s)

results.evidence: The purpose of the WLAN offload acceptability IE is to indicate whether the UE is allowed to use WLAN offload for traffic while using E-UTRAN or while using UTRAN.

results.question: To which specific clause is the operation of the WLAN offload indication IE specified?
results.reference: clause 9.9.4.18

results.question: For which type of connection's traffic does the WLAN offload indication IE apply?

results.evidence: The WLAN offload indication IE indicates whether traffic of the PDN connection can be offloaded to WLAN when a WLAN offloadability indication for E-UTRAN or a WLAN offloadability indication for UTRAN is either not received from lower layers or received but does not indicate that WLAN offload is not acceptable.

results.question: What type of paging indication may be ignored by a UE that requested SMS only?

results.evidence: If the UE requested SMS only in combined attach or combined tracking area updating procedure, but the ATTACH ACCEPT message or TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message does not contain the EPS network feature support IE with the 'SMS only' value, the UE may ignore this message.

results.question: When the UE moves from EMM-IDLE mode to EMM-CONNECTED mode, until the first handover, which PLMN identity shall the UE use?
results.reference: the UE shall use the PLMN identity of the selected PLMN

results.question: What shall the UE do to avoid a synchronisation failure when receiving an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message?
results.reference: the UE shall store the received RAND together with the RES returned from the USIM in the volatile memory of the ME
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.4.2.3, Authentication response by the UE
results.model_answer: If the UE receives an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message containing RAND and AUTN values identical to those in a previously received AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message for which the UE has already returned an AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE or AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message, the UE shall not process the authentication challenge data again (i.e. shall not forward RAND/AUTN to the USIM a second time); instead it shall resend the previously computed AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE or AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message.
results.evidence: If the UE detects that the RAND and AUTN values included in an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message are identical to the RAND and AUTN values received in the previous AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message, and the UE has already responded to that request, in order to avoid a synchronisation failure the UE shall not process the RAND and AUTN and shall resend the response returned for the previous AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.

results.question: Upon receipt of which messages shall the RAND and RES values stored in the ME be deleted?

results.question: Under what condition can the MME include the T3346 value information element?

results.question: During which state may the MME include the T3346 value IE?

results.question: What must be active for the MME to potentially include the T3346 value information element?

results.question: What procedures may the MME initiate during the tracking area updating procedure?
results.reference: the EMM authentication and security mode control procedures
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.5.3.2.3, EMM common procedure initiation

results.question: When shall the MME not initiate an EMM authentication procedure before completion of the tracking area updating procedure?
results.reference:
if the following conditions apply
a) the UE initiated the tracking area updating procedure after handover or inter-system handover to S1 mode
b) the target cell is a shared network cell; and
- the UE has provided its GUTI in the Old GUTI IE or the Additional GUTI IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, and the PLMN identity included in the GUTI is different from the selected PLMN identity of the target cell; or

results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.5.3.2.3, EMM common procedure initiation
results.model_answer: The MME shall not initiate an EMM authentication procedure before completion of the tracking area updating procedure if the UE has a PDN connection for emergency bearer services established.
results.evidence: If the UE has a PDN connection for emergency bearer services established, the MME shall not authenticate the UE before completing the tracking area updating procedure.

results.question: What shall the network do if an integrity-protected ATTACH REQUEST message is received from the UE and successfully integrity checked while a paging procedure is ongoing?
results.reference: the network shall abort the paging procedure

results.model_answer: The network shall abort the paging procedure and proceed with the attach procedure.
results.evidence: If an ATTACH REQUEST message is received with an EPS attach type not set to 'EPS emergency attach' and is successfully integrity checked, and a paging procedure is running for the UE, the network shall stop the paging procedure for the UE and proceed with the attach procedure.

results.question: What shall the network do if it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message in response to a CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION message?
results.reference: the network shall progress the tracking area updating procedure
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.6.2.3.3, Abnormal cases on the network side
results.model_answer: The network shall not treat this as an error, and if there is a need to page the UE for CS fallback, the network should initiate the paging procedure after completion of the tracking area updating procedure.
results.evidence: If the network receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message from the UE as a response to paging for CS fallback, the network shall not treat this as an error, and if there is a need to page the UE for CS fallback, the network should initiate the paging procedure again after completion of the tracking area updating procedure.

results.question: What shall the MME send to the UE and what timer shall it start if the attach request is accepted?
results.reference: send an ATTACH ACCEPT message to the UE and start timer T3450

results.question: Under what condition shall the MME include the T3442 value IE?
results.reference: when the EMM cause value is #39 "CS service temporarily not available"
results.model_answer: The MME shall include the T3442 value IE in the DETACH REQUEST message when the UE performs a combined detach or the network initiates a detach for EPS services and non-EPS services, i.e., when the detach type indicates that the UE is to be detached from both EPS and non-EPS services.

results.reference: #39 "CS service temporarily not available"

results.question: What does the MME do when the EMM cause is #39?

results.question: For which specific EMM cause must the MME include the T3442 value IE?
results.reference: #39 "CS service temporarily not available"

results.question: What shall the UE do regarding attach or combined attach procedure on the expiry of timer T3346 if timer T3346 is running?

results.question: For what type of bearer services may the UE initiate attach even if timer T3346 is running?

results.question: When timer T3346 is running, what procedure may the UE initiate for emergency bearer services?

results.question: Under what condition can the UE provide flight authorization information via protocol configuration options?
results.reference: if the authorization information is already available in the UE
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 6.3.13.4, Authorization of UAV flight
results.model_answer: The UE can include flight authorization information in the Protocol Configuration Options (PCO) IE only if the network has indicated support for the UAS NAS supplementary service (e.g., via a network support indication received in an ATTACH ACCEPT or similar NAS message) and the UE has flight authorization data available to send.
results.evidence: The UE shall not include flight authorisation information in the PCO IE unless the network has indicated support of the UAS NAS supplementary service.

results.question: While in the EMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state, what is the UE waiting for?
results.reference: waiting for a response from the MME
results.model_answer: An indication that DETACH ACCEPT has been received, or that the lower layers indicated that the detach procedure has been completed due to release of the NAS signalling connection, or expiry of timer T3421
results.evidence: The UE shall, in EMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED, wait for a response to the DETACH REQUEST message, i.e. the DETACH ACCEPT message, or expiry of timer T3421.

results.question: What is the specific name of the EMM state entered after requesting EMM context release?
results.reference: EMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED
results.model_answer: EMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED
results.evidence: EMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED: This state is entered when the UE has requested the release of the EMM context.

results.question: Under what condition is the EMM cause IE included in a combined tracking area updating procedure?
results.reference: if the combined tracking area updating procedure was successful for EPS services only
results.model_answer: The EMM cause IE is included when the network initiates the combined tracking area updating procedure and needs to indicate the reason why the request cannot be accepted, i.e., it is included in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message.
results.evidence: EMM cause. This IE is included if the tracking area updating request is rejected by the network.

results.question: For which services must the combined tracking area updating procedure be successful to include the EMM cause IE?
results.reference: for EPS services only
results.model_answer: EPS services only
results.evidence: If the combined tracking area updating procedure has been completed successfully for EPS services only, the EMM cause IE shall be included in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message and shall be set to indicate the reason why the combined tracking area updating procedure was not successful for non-EPS services.

results.question: What procedure triggers the inclusion of the EMM cause IE when successful only for EPS services?
results.reference: the combined tracking area updating procedure
results.model_answer: The tracking area updating procedure
results.evidence: This IE is included if the TAU accept message is sent without having a valid EPS security context, i.e. if EPS services are accepted but ... EMM cause value #40 'no EPS bearer context activated' shall be included when successful for EPS services only.

results.question: What does the network request with the Back-off timer value IE regarding procedure retry?
results.reference: a minimum time interval before procedure retry is allowed
results.model_answer: It requests the UE not to retry the procedure that triggered the back-off timer until the timer expires or is stopped.
results.evidence: The Back-off timer value IE is included by the network to request the UE not to retry the procedure that triggered the timer for a value related to the timer, unless the back-off timer expires or is stopped, or a new PDN connectivity, service request, or bearer resource allocation/modification procedure is initiated by the UE due to a new PDP context activation, new PDN connectivity or service request procedure triggered by the upper layers.

results.question: What is the purpose of the Remote UE report message?
results.reference: to report the remote UE's IP address and port number to the network
results.model_answer: It is used by the UE to inform the network about ProSe Remote UE(s) connected via ProSe UE-to-network relay, providing their user identities (IMSI, IMEI) and/or reporting that a remote UE has become unreachable/disconnected.
results.evidence: The purpose of the REMOTE UE REPORT message is to inform the network about the ProSe remote UE(s) connected and/or disconnected via the UE, acting as ProSe UE-to-network relay.

results.question: What action shall the network take upon the first expiry of timer T3460 during the security mode control procedure?
results.reference: retransmit the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message and shall reset and start timer T3460
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.4.3.7, Abnormal cases on the network side
results.model_answer: The network shall retransmit the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.
results.evidence: Upon the first expiry of the timer T3460, the network shall retransmit the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message and shall reset and restart timer T3460.

results.question: What happens on the fifth expiry of timer T3460 during the security mode control procedure?
results.reference: the procedure shall be aborted
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.4.3.7, Abnormal cases on the network side
results.model_answer: The network shall abort the security mode control procedure and release the RRC connection.
results.evidence: On the fifth expiry of the timer T3460, the network shall abort the procedure and release the RRC connection.

results.question: What is the purpose of serving PLMN rate control?
results.reference: to protect its MME and the signalling radio bearers in the E-UTRAN from load generated by NAS messages with user data over control plane
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 6.3.8, Handling of serving PLMN rate control
results.model_answer: To limit the rate at which the UE or network sends ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages (i.e., user data transported via control plane over NAS/CIoT) to conserve signalling and network resources of the serving PLMN.
results.evidence: The purpose of the serving PLMN rate control is to limit the number of NAS messages (ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages) sent by the UE and the network in a serving PLMN, when data is transported via the control plane, over any access.

results.question: When does the MME start serving PLMN rate control for a PDN connection?
results.reference: when the first NAS message with user data over control plane is received over the PDN connection
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 6.3.8, Handling of serving PLMN rate control
results.model_answer: The MME starts serving PLMN rate control for a PDN connection when that PDN connection is established for use with control plane CIoT EPS optimization (i.e., as soon as the PDN connection using the control plane only option is set up).
results.evidence: The MME shall start serving PLMN rate control for a PDN connection when the PDN connection is established for using the control plane CIoT EPS optimization.

results.question: Under what condition shall a network include the transaction identifier IE?
results.reference: supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode or Iu mode or both
results.model_answer: The network shall include the Transaction identifier IE when it sends an ESM message (e.g. PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT, BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT, BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT, DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST, or ESM STATUS) that relates to a PDN connection or NAS transaction that was requested by the UE via a non-3GPP (e.g. WLAN, using S2c) access, in order to allow the UE to correlate the network's response with the corresponding UE-initiated request sent over that access.
results.evidence: The transaction identifier IE shall be included if the message is sent by the network for a PDN connection using NBIFOM in response to a request received via WLAN (non-3GPP access using S2c), to identify the ESM transaction to which the message relates. (3GPP TS 24.301, subclause 9.9.4.19A / related message clauses)

results.question: What UE capabilities trigger the requirement for the network to include the transaction identifier IE?
results.reference: the UE supports A/Gb mode or Iu mode or both
results.model_answer: The network includes the Transaction identifier IE when the UE has indicated support for header compression for control plane CIoT EPS optimization (i.e., the UE supports control plane CIoT EPS optimization with header compression) and the network decides to use header compression for that PDN connection/EPS bearer.
results.evidence: "Transaction identifier. This IE is included if the UE supports header compression for control plane CIoT EPS optimization and the network decides to use header compression."

results.question: What does the UE do if the service request procedure is triggered by a paging response and NAS signalling connection establishment is rejected?
results.reference: The UE stays in the current serving cell and applies normal cell reselection process.
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.6.1.6, Abnormal cases in the UE
results.model_answer: The UE shall abort the service request procedure and stay in EMM-REGISTERED/EMM-IDLE mode, treating the paging as not answered (i.e., it discards the paging and does not respond further).
results.evidence: If the service request procedure is triggered due to a NAS signalling connection establishment being rejected by the lower layer and the service request procedure was triggered by a paging request, the UE shall abort the service request procedure and consider the paging procedure as not successfully completed.

results.question: On what does the network's initiation of EMM common procedures depend?
results.reference: depending on the received information such as IMSI, GUTI and KSI
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.5.1.3.3, EMM common procedure initiation
results.model_answer: On the network's needs and the current EMM context/state of the UE
results.evidence: The initiation of EMM common procedures by the network depends on the needs of the network and the EMM context and EMM state of the UE.

results.question: What are examples of the received information that influences EMM common procedure initiation?
results.reference: IMSI, GUTI and KSI
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.5.1.3.3, EMM common procedure initiation
results.model_answer: Examples include tracking area identity, radio access technology, and network capability information received from lower layers or in NAS signalling that indicate a change requiring initiation of an EMM common procedure (e.g., GUTI reallocation, authentication, security mode control, or identification procedures).
results.evidence: The EMM common procedures are initiated by the network whenever needed, e.g. based on information received in the ATTACH REQUEST, TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST or other NAS messages, or based on information received from lower layers.

results.question: Who may initiate the EMM common procedures?
results.reference: The network
results.gold_evidence: TS 24.301, Clause 5.5.1.3.3, EMM common procedure initiation
results.model_answer: The network (MME) may initiate the EMM common procedures.
results.evidence: "The EMM common procedures can only be initiated by the network." (3GPP TS 24.301, clause 5.4 General)

results.question: What is the purpose of the ATTACH ACCEPT message?
results.reference: to assign a GUTI and provide the UE with a TAI list
results.model_answer: This message is sent by the network to the UE to indicate that the corresponding attach request has been accepted.
results.evidence: Message type: ATTACH ACCEPT. Direction: network to UE. Significance: dual. This message is sent by the network to the UE to indicate that the corresponding attach request has been accepted.

results.question: To whom is the GUTI assigned and the TAI list provided by the ATTACH ACCEPT message?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer: To the UE
results.evidence: If the GUTI or TAI list is included in the ATTACH ACCEPT message, the UE shall consider the new GUTI or TAI list, respectively, as valid and the old GUTI or TAI list, respectively, as invalid.
